items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: And I didn't play with them too long. Was Ridgely?

ctx.x: I know who you mean. He's an old man now, lives uptown. Yeah, yeah. Up around Calton. On Edinburgh he used to live. Is that the guy Baby Ridgely? Baby Ridgely, yeah.
Baby Ridgely, yeah. And I didn't play with them too long. Was Ridgely?
Was Ridgely a strict reader or did he play by ear too?
